question: Should LINE webhook acceptance be based on a new generic Plugin SDK reply-lane admission contract, or may this PR establish a LINE-specific callback contract and change the shipped ACK-policy surface?
rationale: The choice defines a public plugin/runtime ownership boundary and upgrade behavior; tests cannot decide whether the LINE-local API is an acceptable permanent contract.

options.title: Add the generic admission seam
options.body: Introduce a narrow core/Plugin SDK admission result, migrate LINE to it, and preserve the shipped policy during the transition.

options.title: Approve the LINE-local contract
options.body: Accept the channel-specific callback and ACK-policy change as an intentional compatibility decision with explicit upgrade documentation and contract tests.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Keep the existing immediate ACK behavior until the shared inbound admission design is ready, retaining only the useful regression cases for that follow-up.

recommendation.title: Add the generic admission seam
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow core/Plugin SDK admission result, migrate LINE to it, and preserve the shipped policy during the transition.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer is assigned and already supplied the concrete ownership direction after testing the design.
